    Cruzeiro secured a 1-0 away victory against Barcelona SC
     in their opening match of the 2026 CONMEBOL Libertadores Group Stage, held on April 7, 2026, at the Monumental Stadium in Guayaquil. Matheus Pereira scored the winning goal for Cruzeiro in the second half. 
    Match Key Details (April 7, 2026): 
    • Final Score: Barcelona SC 0-1 Cruzeiro.
    • Goalscorer: Matheus Pereira (Cruzeiro) - 2nd Half.
    • Competition: CONMEBOL Libertadores - Group D, Round 1.
    • Venue: Estadio Monumental Banco Pichincha, Guayaquil, Ecuador. 
    Match Summary: 
    • First Half: A tight, competitive half with few clear chances for either side.
    • Second Half: Matheus Pereira broke the deadlock within 10 minutes of the restart, heading in from a right-wing cross.
    • Result: Cruzeiro successfully defended their lead against mounting pressure from Barcelona SC in the final minutes. 
    Lineups: 
    • Barcelona SC (5-3-2): José Contreras; Álex Rangel, Javier Báez, Luca Sosa, Bryan Carabalí, Gustavo Vallecilla; Milton Céliz, Matías Lugo, Jhonny Quiñónez; Luis Cano, Darío Benedetto.
    • Cruzeiro (4-2-3-1): Matheus Cunha; Fágner, Fabrício Bruno, Jonathan Jesus, Kaiki; Gérson, Lucas Silva; Keny Arroyo, Matheus Pereira, Christian Cardoso; Kaio Jorge.
